openingText: RNR AI Elements provides universal AI chat and agent UI components for React Native. One set of components covers iOS, Android, and Web, so the same chat surface ships on every platform. The library is distributed as a copy-paste registry: you run one command, the item’s source is copied into your project, and the code becomes yours to read and edit. It is not an npm package — you never add a runtime dependency, and no part of the library loads from node_modules.
